verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results. Tasks keep running in the background: progress notifications stream while the task runs, and you poll again with the same thread_id if it is still running. Computer pauses for approval on sensitive actions and relays questions back to you, which covers the review and check-in part of the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete well, and documentation of the consumer-app background-task and review experience (the evidence is mostly from the MCP integration)
